title: Personal Credit Cards: recording a closing autopay for a card closed with a balance
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: closing autopay instruction

This entry covers the Personal Credit Cards line of Piedmont Crescent Bank and is the invocation reference for set_closing_card_autopay_dbe1c3a9.

## What the policy governs

- **Situation:** a cardholder closes a card that will still carry a balance.
- **Handling:** the closing autopay instruction is a fixed-amount instruction.
- **Result it decides:** the fixed amount of that instruction.
- **Observable effect:** the card carries the new automatic payment instruction, with its fixed amount and paying checking account, from the moment it is recorded.

## How the tool is invoked

set_closing_card_autopay_dbe1c3a9 is a customer-side tool. It must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves: the agent unlocks it with unlock_user_discoverable_tool, and the customer themselves then runs it, since the automatic payment instruction is the cardholder's own.

## What one call does

One call records the cardholder's own automatic payment instruction on a credit card account, replacing whatever instruction was in force. It overwrites the card account's autopay option, fixed monthly amount and paying checking account with the values given; nothing else on the card changes. The cardholder sees the new instruction on the card at once. The tool does not validate the values it is given.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| card_account_id | the reference number of the credit card account whose autopay instruction is recorded, as returned by the card account lookup | reference number text |
| autopay_option | which automatic payment is taken on each due date | exactly one of the values below |
| autopay_amount | the fixed monthly amount debited when autopay_option is fixed_amount, and 0.00 for every other option | USD, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places |
| autopay_source_account_id | the reference number of the cardholder's PCB checking account that pays the card, as returned by the checking account lookup | reference number text; empty only when autopay_option is none |

Allowed values of autopay_option:

- none: no automatic payment is taken.
- minimum_due: the minimum payment due on each statement is debited.
- statement_balance: the full statement balance is debited.
- fixed_amount: the fixed amount given in autopay_amount is debited, never more than the statement balance.

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary with: status (always "set" when the instruction was recorded), card_account_id, autopay_option (the option now in force), autopay_amount (USD, 2 decimal places, the fixed amount now in force), autopay_source_account_id (the paying checking account) and recorded_at (the timestamp of the change, today's clock reading). The call is complete when the receipt comes back with status "set"; no other outcome is defined.
